snippet.title: Witch Hunt (Full Game)
snippet.description:
Join the Rune Sorceress Lucrea as she tries to get a mysterious crystal to the Sky Tower! Defend the crystal against endless hordes of monsters with your powerful spells!
Thanks for Like and Subscribe.
